fixed.summary: A game that uses UI stores but draws no UI (no TSX mount, no document) no longer warns at its first tick that the default pack's shapes (`@styles/shared/shapes/*.svg`) and glyph icons (`@styles/shared/glyphs/…`) are not in the cooked bundle: the UI loads its pack's images and icons once a TSX mount or a document mount draws, which is when the cook bundles them.
